statement.excerpt: I've said a lot of this before, which is why I'm not harping on about it, but the most important company in the entire AI industry needs to convert by the end of the year or it's effectively dead, and even if it does, it burns billions and billions of dollars a year and will die without continual funding.
statement.document_title: The Hater's Guide To The AI Bubble

from_speaker: needs to convert by the end of the year
our_interpretation: Conversion means completing the contemplated restructuring of OpenAI's commercial business. It does not require abolishing nonprofit control.
Effectively dead means unable to obtain sufficient financing or sustain substantive operations.
The deadline explicitly applies to conversion; the timing of the predicted business failure is less clear.
This assessment covers the normalized conditional forecast, not the separate statements about annual losses or continual funding.
criteria.support_condition: OpenAI fails to complete the restructuring by December 31, 2025, and that failure makes its business financially or operationally unviable.
criteria.contradiction_condition: OpenAI fails to complete the restructuring by December 31, 2025, but demonstrably retains durable financing and substantive operating viability.
